description: This file contains core functions for a PTM driver, including Linux kernel module initialization, proc filesystem interface creation, and debugging/test routines for specific hardware (VR9). It defines functions for creating and deleting proc entries, handling read/write operations for testing and debugging, as well as utility string and number parsing functions. The code references many external hardware-specific registers and macros, indicating it's part of low-level driver code for a specific hardware platform.

methods.name: void proc_file_create(void)
methods.description: Creates proc filesystem entries for device memory and PP32 debugging interfaces.

methods.name: void proc_file_delete(void)
methods.description: Removes the proc filesystem entries created by proc_file_create.

methods.name: unsigned long sb_addr_to_fpi_addr_convert(unsigned long sb_addr)
methods.description: Converts a buffer address to FPI address space.

methods.description: Handles writing commands to read/write memory using /proc interface.

methods.description: Reads debug status and register dump information from the PP32 core.

methods.description: Processes commands to control PP32 core operation, breakpoints, and debugging via /proc interface.
